coastal.title: Lions Bay evacuation alert rescinded, Lone Tree Creek wildfire now being held
coastal.description: The Lone Tree Creek wildfire was spotted on Sunday afternoon, burning above Lions Bay in an area that was hard for firefighters to reach.

coastal.title: Wildfires surge as B.C. records 11,000 lightning strikes, but rain helps in battle
coastal.description: Lightning sparked new wildfires over the weekend and is the suspected cause of a wildfire that ignited in the Village of Lions Bay, located between Vancouver and Whistler.

coastal.title: Carney says he'll resume negotiating when Trump team has the 'right attitude'
coastal.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney says he's prepared to send his negotiators back to the table with the Trump administration when the U.S. demonstrates it wants a true economic partnership and stops treating Canada as a "subsidiary."

kamloops.title: After decades-long ban, Central Saanich farmers welcome return of potato
kamloops.description: Potato farming was banned in Central Saanich decades ago in response to a devastating pest. However, the Canadian Food Inspection Agency lifted the complete ban in December. Farmers in the area are now harvesting their first potato crop since the 1980s.

all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome.
